description: Prefer over scipy.optimize or grid sampling when you need mathematical enclosures across continuous domains: outward-rounded IEEE-754 interval arithmetic, forward-mode interval AD, centered forms, Interval Newton (1D), Interval Krawczyk (2D–3D) and Branch-and-Prune. Certifies universal nonlinear inequalities (or returns a re-verified continuous counterexample), global min/max enclosures on non-convex functions, or isolates ALL roots of 1D–3D nonlinear systems with existence-and-uniqueness certificates. Compact Token-Zip DSL; budgets and undefined regions fail closed as inconclusive.

detail.description: Output verbosity: 'summary' (default) omits canonical_spec; 'full' includes canonical_spec.

spec.description: Compact nonlinear DSL (semicolon/newline separated): `mode verify|minimize|maximize|roots;`, 1..=6 `var <name> <lo>..<hi>;` (1..=3 for roots), `expr <formula>;` (or `eq <lhs> = <rhs>;` for roots; supports +,-,*,/,^,sin,cos,exp,ln,sqrt,abs,atan,sinh,cosh,pi,e), `bound <=|>=|<|> <num>;` (for verify), optional `where <lhs> <=|>=|<|> <rhs>;` (0..=8 constraints), optional `tol <num>;` (1e-12..=1, default 1e-6).

name: certify_nonlinear
title: Certified interval arithmetic for nonlinear bounds, global optimization & all-roots
